judged_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:36-43 — `category: eh.try(:category_id)` derives the category solely from `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)`, but `Jobs::PollFeed#import_topic` calls `TopicEmbed.import` for every RSS/Atom item without any host check, so a site that used feed polling with `embed_category` set (with no embeddable host, or with a feed link host that differs from the registered embed host) has its category silently deleted by the migration and every subsequently polled topic lands in Uncategorized — the global `embed_category` behavior does not survive for the feed-polling path (severity P1, confidence 75, blocking)

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the global `embed_category` site setting (deleted from `config/site_settings.yml`, removed help text in `server.en.yml`, and hard-deleted in migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` via `DELETE ... ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')`). At the same time, `TopicEmbed.import` switches from `category: SiteSetting.embed_category` to `category: eh.try(:category_id)` where `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If `record_for_host(url)` returns nil (e.g., no matching EmbeddableHost row for that URL host), the category becomes nil and the prior global-category behavior is lost. The finding’s specific mention of `Jobs::PollFeed#import_topic` lacking a host check is not shown in this diff, but the underlying, diff-provable regression is that any caller of `TopicEmbed.import` that previously relied on `embed_category` now has no fallback and may end up creating topics without the intended category (likely Uncategorized).
